chunks: Al-Mudaffar ibn Ja'far ibn Al-Mudaffar al-Alawi al-Samarqandi (may Allah have mercy on him) told us, saying: Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Mas'ud told us, from his father, from Ishaq ibn Muhammad, who said: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Shammun informed me, from Abdullah ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Asam, from Abdullah ibn al-Qasim al-Batal, from Salih ibn Sahl, that he said:
The Commander of the Believers, peace be upon him, is the Lofty Palace, and the Abandoned Well is Fatima and her sons, who are abandoned from rulership.

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Believers (title for Imam Ali)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the 'Abandoned Well' and 'Lofty Palace' in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This metaphorical narration from *Mani al-Akhbar* identifies Imam Ali (AS) as the 'Lofty Palace' (Qasr Mushid) and Fatima (AS) with her sons as the 'Abandoned Well' (Bi'r Mu'tala), symbolizing their spiritual elevation and political deprivation respectively. The term 'abandoned' (mu'tala) specifically highlights the withholding of *al-mulk* (political sovereignty) from the Ahl al-Bayt during the era of the Caliphs, a key concept in Shia historiography regarding the succession dispute.
